scripts.test: xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -project Exchanger.xcodeproj -scheme Exchanger -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' -derivedDataPath .dd test
scripts.release: xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -project Exchanger.xcodeproj -scheme Exchanger -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -archivePath build/Exchanger.xcarchive -allowProvisioningUpdates archive && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath build/Exchanger.xcarchive -exportOptionsPlist ExportOptions.plist -exportPath build -allowProvisioningUpdates
